howGhanaGrowersWorks.title: Farmers join the network
howGhanaGrowersWorks.description: Farmers and farmer groups register their farms, locations, products, seasons, and preferred contact channels.

howGhanaGrowersWorks.title: Buyers post requests or search directories
howGhanaGrowersWorks.description: Market women, restaurants, processors, hotels, and aggregators can search farmers or post active demand.

howGhanaGrowersWorks.title: Suppliers connect with farmers and buyers
howGhanaGrowersWorks.description: Input dealers, packaging firms, logistics providers, and consultants list services that support agricultural trade.

howGhanaGrowersWorks.title: Ghana Growers helps create trusted connections
howGhanaGrowersWorks.description: Verification signals, WhatsApp follow-up, and practical market information help reduce uncertainty before trade.

testimonials.name: Kojo Appiah
testimonials.quote: Ghana Growers makes it easier for buyers to understand what we have available before they come to the farm. It saves time and helps us plan harvest better.

testimonials.name: Esi Nortey
testimonials.quote: The platform gives vegetable farmers like us a more professional way to show our supply, location, and harvest season to serious buyers.

testimonials.name: Akosua Mensah
testimonials.quote: When I need tomatoes, onions, or plantain, I want to know who can supply and when. Ghana Growers brings that information closer.

testimonials.name: Mabel Ofori
testimonials.quote: Suppliers need trusted access to farmers and aggregators. Ghana Growers gives us a channel to explain our products and support farmers better.
